deckTitle: It’s All About Me! (And Also FrizzleBob)

cards.name: The Pond-Gazing Peacock
cards.power: Mirror Loop: Skip 1 turns. If after ripples, take 3 Emotional Damage.
cards.lore: I help you, but I’m currently busy existing as a visual masterpiece.
cards.gradeReason: Perfect opener—self-obsession weaponized into peacock theology.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: vanity satire comic. Subject: peacock admiring reflection endlessly. Mood: majestic narcissism.

cards.name: The Flexing Rooster
cards.power: Intimidating Strut. Use actions in declaring to gain +2 presence.
cards.lore: No one likes me. I am nature’s special effect.
cards.gradeReason: Loud rooster ego card is funny and instantly readable, but simpler than Peacock.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: absurd farm comic. Subject: rooster flexing beside eggs. Mood: loud confidence.

cards.name: The Portrait Poodle
cards.power: Dorian’s Pact. Transfer physical damage to the card in hand.
cards.lore: The painting ages so I don’t have to. Don’t look at the attic.
cards.gradeReason: Vanity dog plus cursed portrait is elegant and brutally on theme.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: gothic satire comic. Subject: poodle staring at aging portrait. Mood: elegant denial.

cards.name: The Selfie-Stick Swan
cards.power: Crop & Filter. Remove “Negative Vibes” from your profile.
cards.lore: If I didn’t post it, did the forest really burn down? Beautiful.
cards.gradeReason: Swan documenting disaster for clout is vicious modern narcissism.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: social media satire comic. Subject: swan taking selfie by fire. Mood: glamorous disaster.

cards.name: The Fog-Weaving Cuttlefish
cards.power: Rewrite History. Force opponent to discard last card and apologize.
cards.lore: I never said that. And if I did, you made me say it.
cards.gradeReason: Gaslighting squid is one of the cleanest mechanics in the whole concept.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: manipulative comic. Subject: cuttlefish blowing fog over argument. Mood: slippery denial.

cards.name: The Mockingbird
cards.power: Tone Policing. Negate your hurt by repeating it in a shiny voice.
cards.lore: You’re crazy. You’re imagining things. You’re just like your mother.
cards.gradeReason: Classic abuse script turned into a bird fight—perfect table poison.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: emotional satire comic. Subject: mockingbird yelling at smaller bird. Mood: cruel mimicry.

cards.name: The Lure-Light Anglerfish
cards.power: Love Bomb. Offer a gift. If accepted, swallow opponent whole next turn.
cards.lore: Mother knows best. Stay in the dark. It’s dangerous out there.
cards.gradeReason: Predator romance card is dark, funny, and mechanically excellent.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: deep sea horror comic. Subject: anglerfish glowing with false warmth. Mood: seductive danger.

cards.name: The Revisionist Owl
cards.power: Alternative Facts. Change game rules mid-turn.
cards.lore: We have always been at war with Eastasia. I have always been the victim.
cards.gradeReason: Library owl rewriting reality is peak narcissist doctrine and great control play.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: library satire comic. Subject: owl rewriting history books. Mood: smug revisionism.

cards.name: The Caped Eagle
cards.power: Bat-Signal. If Adoration drops below 3, laser eye the board.
cards.lore: You grew up near real heroes. I just did.
cards.gradeReason: Patriotic eagle savior complex is strong, though more spectacle than precision.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: superhero satire comic. Subject: eagle in patriotic cape glaring dramatically. Mood: delusional grandeur.

cards.name: The Plagiarist Magpie
cards.power: Memory Loan. Steal an ability. Claim invention.
cards.lore: Fake is fickle, Barry. But stolen shiny objects are forever.
cards.gradeReason: Trophy-thief magpie is clean metaphor and endlessly usable.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: bright satire comic. Subject: magpie stealing trophy labeled mine. Mood: shameless theft.

cards.name: The Smile-Bot Dolphin
cards.power: Performative Empathy. Cry on camera. Gain +3 Support.
cards.lore: I just want to be loved. Is that a crime? (Yes, it is murder.)
cards.gradeReason: Weaponized tears dolphin is savage and immediately funny.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: PR satire comic. Subject: dolphin crying for cameras. Mood: manipulative innocence.

cards.name: The Medal-Heavy General
cards.power: Stolen Valor. Sacrifice minions to gain a medal.
cards.lore: I won two battles I wasn’t even present for. That is leadership.
cards.gradeReason: Pig general collecting glory is brutally efficient satire.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: military satire comic. Subject: pig general covered in medals. Mood: decorated fraud.

cards.name: The Legacy Lion
cards.power: The Family Name. Discard a “Child” card to save reputation.
cards.lore: At least one son somewhere will end up explaining the beige sherbet.
cards.gradeReason: Dynasty lion preserving image through collateral damage is vicious and perfect.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: family dynasty comic. Subject: lion protecting cub with reputation shield. Mood: inherited pressure.

cards.name: The Smothering Kangaroo
cards.power: Infiltrate. Opponent cannot move without permission.
cards.lore: You’ll never leave me. You’re too weak. I made sure of it.
cards.gradeReason: Pocket-prison motherhood is emotionally brutal and mechanically excellent.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: dark family comic. Subject: kangaroo trapping adult child in pouch. Mood: suffocating control.

cards.name: The Wire-Hanger Persian
cards.power: No Wire Hangers. Deal 10 Psychic Damage. Support animal glass breaks.
cards.lore: I gave you life! And this is how you repay me? With dirt?
cards.gradeReason: Maximum theatrical abuse cat—instantly iconic and table-devastating.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: melodramatic comic. Subject: furious fluffy cat screaming at child. Mood: operatic rage.

cards.name: The Golden Child Ant
cards.power: Triangulation. Transfer all blame to Scapegoat.
cards.lore: Why can’t you be more like your brother? He sparkles.
cards.gradeReason: Tiny favoritism monarchy card is cruel, simple, and universally understood.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: family satire comic. Subject: golden ant carried above workers. Mood: smug favoritism.

cards.name: The Business Wolf
cards.power: Silicon Kill. Stun opponent with superior car stock.
cards.lore: Look at that subtle off-white coloring. It’s… tasteful. Beautiful.
cards.gradeReason: Corporate predator flex card is perfect yuppie narcissism parody.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: finance satire comic. Subject: wolf in suit showing luxury business card. Mood: polished menace.

cards.name: The Tech-Bro Ferret
cards.power: Disrupt. Destroy game board. Claim you saved humanity.
cards.lore: Move fast and break things. Mostly people. People are things.
cards.gradeReason: Rocket ferret startup messiah is excellent modern villain energy.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: startup satire comic. Subject: ferret launching sports car rocket. Mood: smug disruption.

cards.name: The Micromanager Queen
cards.power: Ctrl on Reply All. Freeze productivity for 3 turns.
cards.lore: I need you to maximize synergy by asking me before you breathe.
cards.gradeReason: Ant queen bureaucracy weaponized into psychic warfare—beautiful office cruelty.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: office satire comic. Subject: ant queen controlling workers by strings. Mood: oppressive management.

cards.name: The Brand-Ambassador Cheetah
cards.power: Influencer. Convert Followers into currency. Hollow out soul.
cards.lore: It’s not a pyramid scheme. It’s a leveraged opportunity.
cards.gradeReason: Treadmill influencer cat is strong satire, slightly softer mechanically.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: influencer comic. Subject: cheetah running on treadmill selling products. Mood: performative hustle.

cards.name: The Tantrum Hippo
cards.power: Smash. Destroy all cards on table. Including yours.
cards.lore: I ordered the beige iced tea! THE JUNGLE IS BROKEN!
cards.gradeReason: Nuclear meltdown hippo is glorious table-reset comedy.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: chaos comic. Subject: hippo smashing tea set in rage. Mood: explosive entitlement.

cards.name: The Thin-Skinned Balloon Fish
cards.power: Explosive Sensitivity. If criticized, deal 2 damage to everyone.
cards.lore: Are you saying I’m puffy? You’re dead. You’re all dead.

cards.artworkPrompt: Style: reactive comic. Subject: puffed fish glaring at tiny criticism. Mood: overreaction.

cards.name: The Spiteful Wasp
cards.power: Petty Vengeance. Spend all energy to inflict 1 point of annoyance.
cards.lore: I don’t want the honey. I just want the flower to suffer.
cards.gradeReason: Petty wasp philosophy is one of the funniest pure-spite cards here.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: petty comic. Subject: wasp attacking flower out of spite. Mood: vindictive joy.

cards.name: The Scream-Pillar
cards.power: Sonic Wall. Silence all logic.
cards.lore: AAAAAAAAAAAAAA (Pay attention to me!)
cards.gradeReason: Literal screaming caterpillar with megaphone is perfect absurd narcissist design.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: absurd comic. Subject: caterpillar megaphone screaming from leaf. Mood: demanding attention.

cards.name: The Gauntlet Gorilla
cards.power: The Snap. Remove 50% of the deck. Perfectly balanced.
cards.lore: I’m the only one with the will to act. Also, I own a banana.
cards.gradeReason: Infinity-gauntlet ape narcissism is stupid perfection and amazing table violence.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: superhero satire comic. Subject: gorilla wearing cosmic gauntlet proudly. Mood: absolute dominance.

cards.name: The Note-Writing Rat
cards.power: Delete. Write a name. Eliminate after 40 seconds.
cards.lore: I will become God of the new sewer.
cards.gradeReason: Petty narcissist with death notebook is elegant, dark, and hilarious.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: noir comic. Subject: rat writing names in cursed notebook. Mood: smug omnipotence.

cards.name: The Sun-King Scarab
cards.power: Divine Right. All players must bow (skip turn) or be blamed.
cards.lore: Without me, the day does not start. Worship the sphere!
cards.gradeReason: Dung-beetle monarchy is peak cosmic ego and table-ready tyranny.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: royal myth comic. Subject: scarab rolling glowing sun crown. Mood: divine self-importance.

cards.name: The Clockwork Kraken
cards.power: Mechanize. Turn organic cards into rigid metal.
cards.lore: Nature is messy. I have fixed it. You’re welcome.
cards.gradeReason: Control-freak robot squid is strong flavor, though more support than star.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: steampunk comic. Subject: mechanical kraken replacing ocean with gears. Mood: cold perfection.

cards.name: The Flying Monkey
cards.power: Proxy War. Attack opponent. Narcissist takes no blame.
cards.lore: The Boss is actually really nice once you get to know him!
cards.gradeReason: Weaponized minion monkey is mandatory narcissist deck architecture.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: wicked satire comic. Subject: flying monkey carrying gossip bombs. Mood: cheerful sabotage.

cards.name: The Doormat Turtle
cards.power: Absorb Abuse. Take double damage so Narcissist takes none.
cards.lore: If I just stay quiet, maybe he won’t yell today.
cards.gradeReason: Tragic shell-card is emotionally brutal and mechanically perfect.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: sad comic. Subject: turtle hiding under heavy footsteps. Mood: exhausted survival.

cards.name: The Yes-Parrot
cards.power: Echo Chamber. Double effectiveness of Gaslighting.
cards.lore: Brilliant, sir! Genius, sir! You’re so right, sir!
cards.gradeReason: Approval bird turns abuse into infrastructure—excellent support engine.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: bright satire comic. Subject: parrot shouting yes repeatedly. Mood: eager compliance.

cards.name: The Energy Vampire Bat
cards.power: Vibe Kill. Drain 2 Action Points from every player.
cards.lore: I don’t drink blood. I drink your will to live.
cards.gradeReason: Social exhaustion bat is universally understood and viciously playable.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: gothic comic. Subject: bat draining rainbow from parrot. Mood: emotional depletion.

cards.name: The Magic Mirror
cards.power: Validation Loop. Recover full health by lying to yourself.
cards.lore: You are the fairest. Everyone else is trash.
cards.gradeReason: Literal self-worship mirror is foundational narcissist technology.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: enchanted comic. Subject: bodybuilder admiring magical mirror reflection. Mood: delusional validation.

cards.name: The Pedestal
cards.power: High Ground. +5 Attack, but instant death if you fall.
cards.lore: It’s lonely at the top. But the view of you is great.
cards.gradeReason: Perfect metaphor card—huge power with inevitable catastrophic collapse.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: symbolic comic. Subject: towering pedestal in storm clouds. Mood: fragile superiority.

cards.name: The Black Hole Smartphone
cards.power: Doomscroll. Paralyze opponent with envy.
cards.lore: Feed me attention. I am starving in 4K resolution.
cards.gradeReason: Attention-singularity phone is modern, brutal, and very funny.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: digital satire comic. Subject: phone becoming cosmic black hole. Mood: addictive hunger.

cards.name: The Crown of Thorns (Fake)
cards.power: Victim Card. Immunity to criticism by claiming persecution.
cards.lore: Look how much I suffer for you! LOOK AT IT!
cards.gradeReason: Martyr cosplay crown is vicious and one of the strongest social weapons here.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: dramatic comic. Subject: fake crown over giant crying eye. Mood: theatrical suffering.

cards.name: The Vacuum Cleaner Parent
cards.power: Hoovering. Pull discarded “Child” cards back into play under your control.

cards.artworkPrompt: Style: domestic satire comic. Subject: vacuum parent sucking adult child backward. Mood: manipulative return.

cards.name: The Spreadsheet Cobra

cards.artworkPrompt: Style: office satire comic. Subject: cobra guarding giant spreadsheet. Mood: precision domination.

cards.name: The Guilt Octopus
cards.power: Emotional Ink. Mark opponent; every action they take hurts them.
cards.lore: After all I’ve done for you, this is how you repay me? With boundaries?

cards.artworkPrompt: Style: emotional horror comic. Subject: octopus wrapping victim in guilt ribbons. Mood: suffocating obligation.

cards.name: The Breadcrumb Fox

cards.artworkPrompt: Style: manipulative comic. Subject: fox dangling tiny golden breadcrumb. Mood: false hope.

cards.name: The Reputation Swan
cards.power: Public Angel. Negate all accusations while witnesses are present.
cards.lore: Everyone thinks I’m wonderful because I perform kindness like Olympic fencing.
cards.gradeReason: Public/private split made into swan warfare—perfect narcissist architecture.

cards.name: The Scapegoat Goat
cards.power: Blame Transfer. All negative effects move to this card automatically.

cards.name: The Grey Rock Sloth
cards.power: Become Uninteresting. Opponent cannot target you for two turns.
cards.lore: I have no opinions, no reactions, and suddenly your circus is someone else’s problem.

cards.name: The Therapist Raven
cards.power: Pattern Recognition. Reveal the hidden motive of one opponent card.
cards.lore: Fascinating. Tell me more about why every villain in your story has your mother’s haircut.

cards.name: The Inner Child Possum
cards.power: Panic Response. Play dead. Avoid all consequences this round.
cards.lore: My coping strategy is ancient, dramatic, and surprisingly effective.
cards.gradeReason: Trauma possum is funny and relatable, though more utility than headline.

cards.name: The Exit Door
cards.power: Leave. End the interaction immediately. Win by absence.
cards.lore: The strongest move against narcissism is often cardio.
cards.gradeReason: Literal walking away as a win condition is beautiful design philosophy.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: symbolic comic. Subject: glowing exit door beyond chaos storm. Mood: liberation.

cards.name: The Monkey Branch Tarzan
cards.power: Immediate Replacement. Before grieving, swing to a new relationship.
cards.lore: I’m not avoiding intimacy. I’m just extremely efficient with vines.
cards.gradeReason: Relationship parkour as coping mechanism is hilarious and painfully accurate.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: jungle satire comic. Subject: monkey swinging from ex to ex. Mood: frantic avoidance.

cards.name: The Crystal Unicorn Empath
cards.power: Spiritual Superiority. Ignore criticism because your aura is objectively better.
cards.lore: I’m not selfish. I’m just vibrating at a frequency you can’t afford.
cards.gradeReason: Wellness narcissism unicorn is excellent satire, though slightly softer mechanically.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: pastel absurd comic. Subject: unicorn floating above peasants glowing smugly. Mood: enlightened arrogance.

cards.name: The Revenge Spreadsheet Bride
cards.power: Wedding Ledger. Track every insult and cash it in later.
cards.lore: I forgive nothing. I merely laminate it.
cards.gradeReason: Petty archival warfare is magnificent and terrifyingly relatable.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: domestic noir comic. Subject: bride guarding giant revenge spreadsheet. Mood: elegant vengeance.

cards.name: FrizzleBob’s Mirror
cards.power: Radical Reflection. Force every player to admit one ugly truth.
cards.lore: The mirror doesn’t judge. It just laughs softly and writes notes.
cards.gradeReason: Mascot therapy mirror perfectly shifts chaos into confession and table comedy.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: mascot comic. Subject: rabbit holding haunted therapy mirror. Mood: playful confrontation.

cards.name: Rule 1 – Attention Is Currency
cards.power: Steal applause. Gain +3 power whenever anyone reacts.
cards.lore: Silence is death. Validation is breakfast.
cards.gradeReason: Perfect thesis rule—short, vicious, and universally true for this deck.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: manifesto comic. Subject: spotlight feeding monster with applause. Mood: hungry validation.

cards.name: Rule 2 – Never Apologize
cards.power: Reverse Blame. Turn any accusation into their fault.
cards.lore: Sorry is for people with stable identities.
cards.gradeReason: Core narcissist doctrine translated into brutally clean gameplay.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: sharp satire comic. Subject: fox redirecting accusation arrows backward. Mood: shameless deflection.

cards.name: Rule 3 – Burn the Script
cards.power: Flip the table narrative. Rewrite who the villain is.
cards.lore: If reality disagrees with your story, reality is clearly toxic.
cards.gradeReason: Narrative arson is the philosophical heart of the whole deck.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: chaotic comic. Subject: burning script pages swirling around throne. Mood: glorious revision.

cards.name: Rule 4 – Stay Fluffy
cards.power: End the game. Leave smiling.
cards.lore: Survive the ego circus, keep your boundaries, and remain an adorable menace.
cards.gradeReason: Perfect final rule—escape, dignity, and fluffy rebellion in one closer.

Style: mascot punk comic. Subject: fluffy rabbit walking away from exploding circus. Mood: liberated triumph.

## QA

qa.verdict: This deck is emotional warfare turned into a zoo documentary, and it absolutely slaps. The strongest cards—The Fog-Weaving Cuttlefish, The Exit Door, Rule 3 – Burn the Script—work because they convert real narcissist patterns into clean table violence without losing the comedy. It’s funny, mean, and weirdly therapeutic. Table-ready? Completely. Just watch who gets defensive around the Boundary Alarm Cat.

urgent: Clean a few OCR-rough lore lines around family trauma cards for perfect readability
quickWins: Standardize naming consistency between archetype animals and manifesto rule cards
Slightly sharpen Crystal Unicorn Empath for stronger gameplay bite
niceToHave: Small icon consistency pass across the final FrizzleBob/rules page

notes: Cover page is decorative only and not counted as a gameplay page. The final rule cards intentionally shift from satire into survival doctrine and should preserve that tone. This deck works because every card reinforces the same lesson: narcissism is theater, and the strongest counterplay is refusing the audition.
marketingText:
Kayfabizarro: IT'S ALL ABOUT ME! – A Field Guide to Narcissists, Their Enablers, and the Exit Door (Free Cut & Play Comic Card Game)

Narcissism is a one-actor play that quietly drafts everyone else in the room into the supporting cast.

You know the dinner where one person's mood sets the weather for eight other people. The sulk that reorganizes the whole evening, the grievance rehearsed so often it has stage directions, the apology you somehow end up being the one to give. Nobody named the parts out loud, so you kept playing yours: audience, stagehand, understudy for the blame. That is the entire trick. The show only runs as long as the cast keeps showing up on cue.

This is Social Story Wrestling for the family system you were taught to stay polite about. 48 cut-and-play cards rate every player on three stats, Rage (how loud it gets when you say no), Adoration (how many likes it needs to survive the round), and Fraud (how thick the mask is), and the table decides who actually wins the scene.

WHAT'S INSIDE?
- The "It's All About Me!" Core Deck: 48 High-Res "Print, Cut & Play" Cards, featuring The Spiteful Wasp, The Cross-Bearing Donkey, and The Truth Bomb.
- The Freestyle Rules: the complete Anti-Rulebook, titled "How to Wrestle a Pig (Without Getting Dirty)". No complicated math, just storytelling, dice-driven chaos, and the discipline of not taking the bait.
- The RAF Engine: the narcissist archetypes, the enablers and scapegoats who keep them fed, and the hazard, counter, and structure cards that run all the way to The Exit Door.

WHY "PAY WHAT YOU WANT"?
I make these because naming the move is the first thing that takes its power away, and most people learn the pattern years too late, alone, and convinced the whole thing was their own fault. Are you broke, or counting every coin this month? Enter "0" and take it. Play it. Name the types out loud until they stop sounding like fate. Want to support the craft? Every dollar goes straight into the next deck.

Choose your reality. Become an Epistemic Outlaw.
"The narcissist only owns the spotlight you agree to keep holding. Set it down and walk."
Stay fluffy. — Uncle FrizzleBob
